svg.title: Generated travel site — desktop layout
svg.desc:
A figure, not a screenshot. Vector rendering of the site design system in reference/site-layout-spec.md sections 1-3 (typography, colour architecture, component catalog) laid out per section 4 Desktop, drawn against the tracked synthetic fixture in this directory. Every name, date, time, event ID, venue key, booking posture and count shown here is taken verbatim from a file in examples/data-architecture-demo/; nothing is invented. The per-trip accent is an azulejo blue, chosen at site-build time as CLAUDE.md's Design Principles describe. The map panel is schematic — pin positions are not geographic, and no tile layer is drawn because CartoDB tiles are CDN-loaded. Committed as source: edit this file directly; there is no build step and no capture step.
Scale: this figure is drawn at FIGURE scale, not at the site's own pixel scale. The canvas is 896 units wide because that is the width a README renders it at; one unit is one displayed pixel there, and about 0.77 of one at the narrower widths GitHub also uses. Section 1's type scale is therefore rendered in proportion rather than copied as literal unit values — a 0.52rem pill is 8.3px on a 1200px page viewed at 100%, and a figure that declared 8.5 units here would paint it at about 5px. Sizes below are floored so the smallest text stays legible at the narrowest rendered width; the figure is consequently taller than one desktop viewport, which is the trade this figure makes to keep every label readable. If you edit this file, keep the floor: no font-size below 14.5.
